author: hubitrep

drivers.name: Universal Electronics / Visonic / Xfinity Contact Sensor

releaseNotes: 0.1.8: driver 0.1.9: the sensor polls its router every 6 s instead of 2 s; the hourly check-in is answered, and preference changes go out at the next check-in (Configure and pairing send at once); the configuration is sent again when battery reports stop or a new battery is detected; Refresh goes out on the sensor's next message and resends unanswered reads; added the Battery saver (experimental) preference and the rejoinCount attribute; invalid battery and temperature readings are ignored; a temperature calibration offset no longer adds stray decimals.
